China's central bank bought 20.2 tonnes of gold in August, its fastest monthly pace since resuming purchases in November 2022 — a 22-month streak now totalling 438.3 tonnes, State Administration of Foreign Exchange reserve data show.

中國人民銀行八月增持黃金20.2吨，是2022年11月重啟購金以來最快的月度步伐；這波連續增持已達22個月，累計438.3吨，據國家外匯管理局儲備數據。

Carried across mainland and Hong Kong financial press, including Eastmoney.
